name: Elizabeth
source:
Pam, a 40 year old woman comes to the bus stop after getting excessively drunk at her birthday celebration. Slightly disillusioned with life, she meets a middle school girl there. Depending on the player's choices can their dynamic range from 'sweet' to 'angry' to 'downright creepy'. Including a couple of different endings and a gameplay of around 10 minutes, this is a short VN that talks about the experience of growing up, and seeing yourself reflected in someone younger.

[from [url=https://cheesychilaquil.itch.io/elizabeth]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
帕姆 (Pam) 是一位40岁的女性，她在庆祝生日时喝得酩酊大醉，来到公交车站。对生活略感失望的她在那里遇见了一名中学生。根据玩家的选择，他们的动态范围可以从“甜蜜”到“愤怒”到“彻头彻尾的令人毛骨悚然”。这是一个简短的VN，包含几个不同的结局和大约10分钟的游戏玩法，讲述了成长的经历，以及在年轻人身上看到自己的影子。

[来自[url=https://cheesychilaquil.itch.io/elizabeth]itch.io[/url]]
